description_en: Deletes the specified port forwarding rule
description_zh: 删除指定的端口转发规则
kebab_example: aliyun ddoscoo delete-port --frontend-port 55 --frontend-protocol tcp --instance-id ddoscoo-cn-st21zbyq0000 --api-version 2020-01-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePort

parameters.help_en: The forwarding port. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.name: frontend_port

parameters.help_en:
The type of the forwarding protocol. Valid values:

tcp
udp
parameters.help_zh:
转发协议类型。取值：
tcp：表示TCP协议。
udp：表示UDP协议
parameters.name: frontend_protocol

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance to which the port forwarding rule belongs.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html operation to query the IDs of all instances
parameters.help_zh:
端口转发规则所属的DDoS高防实例的ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/157459.html查询所有DDoS高防实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The port of the origin server. Valid values: 0 to 65535
parameters.name: backend_port

parameters.help_en: An array that consists of the IP addresses of origin servers
parameters.name: real_servers

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
